meaning.en: Ever ready to fulfil the purpose of the gods
meaning.hi: देवताओं के कार्य को सिद्ध करने के लिए तत्पर

explanation.en: She arose for a purpose: the work of the gods, who had prayed for help against the demon Bhaṇḍāsura. Samudyatā means fully ready, so she appears already set on the task.

inner.en: The gods are also our own luminous faculties, and their task is freedom from Bhaṇḍāsura, the demon born from the ashes of Kāma: desire burnt but not destroyed. She rises, eager and ready, to free the seeker from that ego.

story.en: Bhaṇḍāsura was formed from the ashes of Kāma, the god of desire, after Śiva burnt him with his third eye. Grown mighty, he drove the gods from heaven, and this name says the Devī rose ready to end that tyranny.
